tasks.label: Deploy backend to app service
tasks.command: cd ${workspaceFolder}/backend && rm -f app.zip && zip -r app.zip . -x "venv/*" "__pycache__/*" "*.pyc" ".env" "tests/*" "test_*.py" >/dev/null && cd ${workspaceFolder} && az webapp deploy --resource-group MartaPoetryRG --name marta-poetry-app --src-path backend/app.zip --type zip --restart true --clean true --async true && echo '✓ Deployment submitted. Waiting for app to start...' && sleep 90 && echo '--- Health check ---' && curl -s --max-time 15 https://marta-poetry-app.azurewebsites.net/ && echo '' && curl -s --max-time 20 https://marta-poetry-app.azurewebsites.net/api/debug/graph-status | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f\"Graph: {d.get(\\\"total_poems\\\",0)} poems\")" 2>/dev/null || true && echo '' && echo '--- Audio endpoint check ---' && curl -s --max-time 20 -X POST https://marta-poetry-app.azurewebsites.net/api/audio/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"route\":\"27323\",\"poem_text\":\"test\",\"voice\":\"nova\",\"speed\":0.9}" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Audio OK' if d.get('success') else f\"Audio error: {d.get('detail') or d.get('error')}\")" 2>/dev/null || true
